第二十四章 师尊远行组队守田（第1页）
陈默与小白狐闭关突破境界后，林家内外的气氛愈发凝重。远方不断传来灵力碰撞的轰鸣，偶尔还有凌厉破空之声掠过天际，叶、武两家与林家前线弟子的交锋已然白热化，战火一步步逼近府邸。
谁也没料到，坐镇别院的韩东竟在此时选择外出。临行前他单独唤来陈默，言语简练：“城中纷争不休，我需外出一趟。府中已有安排，你去后山值守灵田，安分行事。”
寥寥数语，并无过多解释。陈默躬身应下，心中却清楚，后山远离前线主战场，是相对安全的去处，师尊分明是特意将他安置在稳妥之地。
韩东离去没多久，宗门执事便传令编组布防。后山灵田栽种着各类珍稀灵药，是家族重要根基，不容有失，陈默按安排归入一支守备小队。小队一共五人，由一名筑基女修统领，另有三名炼气弟子，连同陈默一同驻守。
一行人来到后山灵田旁的值守木屋，此地灵气氤氲，成片灵药长势喜人，只是周遭静得让人心里发慌。
为首的女子名为苏晚晴，筑基初期修为，一身青衫素净，眉眼清冷，立在那里便自有一股沉稳气场。她目光缓缓扫过众人，语调平淡无波：“前线战事吃紧，援兵难以及时赶到。我们的职责是守住灵田，各司其职，遇事切莫莽撞。”
她说话时神色始终淡淡的，话语不多，却字字透着稳妥。目光掠过陈默时，不着痕迹地多停留了一瞬，这细微的举动落在旁人眼里并不起眼，可陈默心中明白，这是师尊临行前有所托付。
身材壮实的赵磊站在一旁，瓮声瓮气地接话：“队长放心，有我守着路口，寻常宵小休想靠近半步。”他嗓门洪亮，脊背挺得笔直，手掌不自觉按在腰间兵刃上，憨厚的脸上满是认真，一看便是踏实肯干、敢打敢拼的性子。
旁边身形偏瘦的周扬闻言缩了缩脖子，左右张望一番，压低声音嘟囔：“话虽如此，前线打得那么凶，万一有敌人绕后偷袭，那可就麻烦了。我听说刚才前院都有零散修士闯进来了。”他眼珠转个不停，时不时望向山林深处，满脸忌惮，行事机灵却也格外惜命。
一旁的少女许巧闻言心头一紧，下意识攥紧了袖口，柔声开口：“大家多加小心便是，若是有人受了伤，我这里备了疗伤的药粉。”她声音轻柔，举止腼腆，目光始终落在身前的灵药植株上，性子内敛柔弱，一心只想着做好分内的后勤之事。
几人简单交谈几句，便划分好了值守班次。
山风穿过林间，夹杂着远处隐约的厮杀呐喊，一声声传至后山，让这片看似安宁的灵田也笼罩上一层紧张。周扬时不时探头望向山道，坐立难安，明显满心不安；赵磊则主动守在木屋外的要道，寸步不离，警惕地扫视四方，尽责值守；许巧安静整理着随身的药瓶，指尖微微收紧，神色惴惴不安。
苏晚晴独自立于灵田边缘，周身灵力隐隐运转，看似眺望远方战场的方向，实则大半注意力都暗中留意着陈默的动向。她谨记韩东的嘱托，不动声色地将周遭动静尽收眼底，默默为其挡去潜在的风险。
陈默靠在木屋墙边，肩头的小白狐蜷着身子，火红眼眸半眯，看似休憩，实则也感知着四方气息。他看着眼前几位同伴各异的神态举止，又听着远方不绝的战响，心绪沉静下来。
有师尊暗中安排庇护，有筑基修士带队照看，此地虽非绝对安全，却远比前线安稳。他握紧袖中的阴魄剑，暗自打定主意，值守之余，继续打磨修为与剑术，静静等待局势演变。

Chapter 24 Master travels far and forms a team to guard the field (page 1)
After Chen Mo and Little White Fox broke through the realm in seclusion, the atmosphere inside and outside the Lin family became more solemn. The roar of collision of spiritual powers continued to be heard in the distance, and occasionally there was a sharp sound of piercing the sky. The confrontation between the Ye and Wu families and the frontline disciples of the Lin family had become intense, and the war was approaching the mansion step by step.
No one expected that Han Dong, who was sitting in another courtyard, would choose to go out at this time. Before leaving, he called Chen Mo alone and said concisely: "There are endless disputes in the city, and I need to go out. The government has made arrangements. You go to the back mountain to guard the spiritual field and behave in a safe manner."
Just a few words and not much explanation. Chen Mo bowed in agreement, but he knew in his heart that the back mountain was a relatively safe place far away from the main battlefield on the front line. The master clearly placed him in a safe place deliberately.
Not long after Han Dong left, the sect's deacon sent an order to organize and deploy defenses. Various rare elixirs are grown in the back mountain spiritual field, which is an important foundation of the family and cannot be lost. Chen Mo was assigned to a defense team as arranged. There are five people in the team, led by a female foundation-building cultivator. There are also three Qi Refining disciples stationed together with Chen Mo.
A group of people came to the guard wooden house next to the spiritual field in the back mountain. The place was full of spiritual energy, and the elixirs were growing happily, but the surroundings were so quiet that it made people feel panicked.
The woman in the lead is named Su Wanqing. She is in the early stage of foundation building. She is dressed in a pure blue shirt and has cold eyebrows. She has a calm aura when she stands there. Her eyes slowly swept over the crowd, and her tone was calm: "The fighting on the front line is tight, and it is difficult for reinforcements to arrive in time. Our duty is to guard the spiritual field, each performs his or her duties, and must not be reckless when encountering trouble."
Her expression was always calm when she spoke, and she didn't speak much, but her words were all composed. When his eyes passed over Chen Mo, he stayed for a moment without leaving any trace. This subtle move was inconspicuous in the eyes of others, but Chen Mo knew in his heart that this was an entrustment entrusted to him by his master before leaving.
The stout Zhao Lei stood aside and answered in a deep voice: "Captain, don't worry, I'm guarding the intersection. You can't get even half a step closer during the night." His voice was loud, his back was straight, his palms were unconsciously pressed on the weapons at his waist, and his honest face was full of seriousness. At first glance, he showed a down-to-earth, hardworking, and daring temperament.
Zhou Yang, who was slim next to him, shrank his neck when he heard this, looked around, and murmured in a low voice: "Having said that, the battle on the front line is so fierce, if the enemy sneaks around to attack, it will be troublesome. I heard that there were scattered monks breaking in in the front yard just now." His eyes kept turning, looking deep into the forest from time to time, his face was full of fear, and he acted smartly but also cherished his life.
Xu Qiao, a girl on the side, felt her heart tighten when she heard the words. She subconsciously clenched her sleeves and said softly, "Please be careful. If anyone is injured, I have prepared healing powder here." Her voice was soft and her behavior was shy. Her eyes were always on the elixir plant in front of her. Her temperament was introverted and weak, and she only thought about doing her logistical duties.
A few people exchanged a few words and divided the duty shifts.
The mountain wind passed through the forest, mixed with the faint shouts of fighting in the distance, and the sound spread to the back mountain, making this seemingly peaceful spiritual field enveloped with a layer of tension. Zhou Yang looked towards the mountain road from time to time, sitting uneasily and obviously full of uneasiness; Zhao Lei took the initiative to guard the main road outside the wooden house, never leaving, scanning all directions vigilantly, and performing his duty; Xu Qiao quietly arranged the medicine bottles he carried with him, his fingertips tightened slightly, and he looked uneasy.
Su Wanqing stood alone on the edge of the spiritual field, her spiritual power faintly moving around her body. She seemed to be looking in the direction of the distant battlefield, but in fact most of her attention was secretly paying attention to Chen Mo's movements. She kept Han Dong's instructions in mind and quietly took in all the happenings around her, silently shielding him from potential winds.risk.
Chen Mo leaned against the wall of the wooden house, the little white fox on his shoulder curled up, his fiery red eyes half-squinted, seemingly resting, but in fact he was sensing the aura from all directions. He looked at the different expressions and behaviors of the companions in front of him, and listened to the constant sound of fighting in the distance, and his mind calmed down.
The master secretly arranges shelter, and the foundation-building monks lead a team to look after them. Although this place is not absolutely safe, it is far safer than the front line. He grasped the Yin Po Sword tightly in his sleeve and secretly made up his mind. While on duty, he continued to hone his cultivation and swordsmanship, and quietly waited for the situation to evolve.
